meaning.en: A variety of onion with pointed, pear-shaped bulbs that grow in clusters.
meaning.vi: Là loại hành có củ nhọn, hình quả lê, mọc thành từng chùm.

meaning.en: The mild-flavored bulb of this plant, used in cooking.

meaning.en: A small onion (Allium ascalonicum) whose clustered bulbs, like garlic but milder, are used for flavoring.

meaning.en: A vegetable in the onion family.  Allium ascalonium. Allium oschaninii. Any small onion. (New Orleans) A scallion.
